# Blackland Restoration Co. — Plano, TX

24/7 emergency water damage restoration company serving Plano, Texas (ZIPs 75023, 75024, 75025, 75026, 75074, 75075, 75086, 75093, 75094). Services: water mitigation, extraction, structural drying, flood restoration, sewage cleanup, slab leaks, burst pipes, appliance/water-heater/AC leaks, ceiling & drywall repair, bathroom overflows, hardwood floor drying, carpet drying, mold remediation, moisture inspection, reconstruction, fire damage restoration, contents pack-out, commercial restoration.

Phone: (214) 833-4785 — 24/7 emergency line.
